alternative_fix_sites: junction/planner.py::can_change (any inclusive comparison, e.g. not departure - arrival < transfer)
notes: A change between trips at the same station needs MORE than the minimum transfer time instead of at least that time. Journeys whose only (or latest-departing) option uses exactly the transfer time get a later arrival or an earlier departure. Gaps longer than the transfer time and changes after a walk are unaffected (public tests). Probes use stations with transfer times 0, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 and 7, the API, the text format and journeys(), so special-casing the report's station or 5 minutes fails.
